opening.argument: The speaker promotes Bit Club Network as a Bitcoin-mining opportunity, describing it as “the only crowd-funded mining thing” and stating that “everybody's coming on for 599.” He presents participation through payments of $599 and $2,000, invites viewers to join, and claims the network can make money automatically: “we show you how to do that automatically at Bitclub Network.” He compares the network to a money-printing press and says he made $300 in one hour. His report that “People are joining” reinforces the invitation to participate. Although he acknowledges that some cryptocurrency MLM companies are fake, the available evidence does not verify contract terms, mining results, typical earnings, or participant outcomes.
